overview_description.description:
Upverter lets engineers build hardware at software speeds.

The first and only fully-cloud, full-stack, design platform for hardware (data, collaboration, marketplace & editor).

Launched out of beta with the parts concierge, professional and enterprise on-premise at the start of October 2015.

product.name: Upverter Modular Design Platform
product.description: A web-based tool for designing electronic hardware including PCB design, schematics, automated routing, and 3D previews.

product.name: Upverter Board Builder
product.description: A feature to quickly assemble custom circuit boards by selecting processors, sensors, and networking modules without manual routing.

product.name: Upverter Template Library
product.description: A collection of pre-designed templates and modules for electronics design to accelerate project development.

product.name: Upverter 3D Design Preview
product.description: A browser-based 3D visualization tool for reviewing and sharing electronic hardware designs.

product.name: Upverter Manufacturing and Fulfillment Service
product.description: A service providing pre-tested custom PCB manufacturing and delivery with software support packages.
